# FDG3061

> DO use a plural type name for an enumeration with bit fields as values, also called flags enum.

Framework Design Guidelines, 3rd edition, section 3.5.3 Naming Enumerations.

## How it is checked

- Check: judgment
- Automatic fix: no
- Severity: library warning, application warning, test none
- Status: verified

## From the book

```csharp
[Flags]
public enum ConsoleModifiers {
  Alt = 1 << 0,
  Control = 1 << 1,
  Shift = 1 << 2,
}
```
